title: Horizon Listener Webhook Payload (v1)
description: Webhook payload schema for WEBHOOK_SCHEMA_VERSION = "v1". Supports both a single-event body `{ event }` and a batched body `{ events }`.

rawContractEvent.description: A raw contract event emitted by the Stellar network.

id.description: Unique identifier for the contract event.

contractId.description: Contract identifier (e.g. C... address) that emitted the event.

ledger.description: Ledger sequence number in which the event was emitted.

topic.description: Ordered list of topic segments (typically base64-encoded XDR values).

value.description: Base64-encoded XDR value of the event body.

batchedEventsBody.description: Batched webhook body containing multiple events.

events.description: List of contract events included in this batch.
